newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps rates Merrill Lynch offering.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates Merrill Lynch offering.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it rated Merrill Lynch & Co Inc's offering of 12 billion yen of 1.94 percent Eurobonds Double A. The notes mature on November 21, 2001.
Duff & Phelps' recent upgrade of Merrill Lynch's senior debt obligations reflect the view that Merrill Lynch's operating strategy has successfully reduced revenue volatility through market cycles.
The rating continues to reflect Merrill Lynch's high level of profitability and solid operating performance, Duff & Phelps said.
